ddos.title: DDoS global settings
ddos.description: Configure application-layer protection such as slow-attack limits, request size and connection limits.

ipRules.description: Block or allow IPs manually and review automatically blocked addresses.

blockedPaths.description: Define internal paths that respond 404 / 403 directly, with allowed exception sources.

tracing.description: Enable distributed tracing, configure sampling, and open Jaeger / Grafana.

services.title: Services
services.emptyHint: No services yet. Click "Add service" to create your first API.
services.searchPlaceholder: Search name, key, domain or path

fields.serviceKeyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; cannot be changed later

entry.title: Entries
entry.pathHelp: Starts with /. {id} matches one segment, {**catch-all} matches everything after it, e.g. /api/orders/{id}, /api/orders/{**catch-all}
entry.hostsHelp: Domains clients connect with. Multiple allowed (Enter, comma or space); empty means all domains. e.g. api.example.com, *.example.com, api.example.com:8443
entry.overlapWarning: Entries {{a}} and {{b}} share the same path. Adjust their priority; publishing validates again.
entry.minOne: At least one entry is required

backend.receivingHelp: "Receives traffic" is not a direction; it decides whether this host gets requests. Turned off, the host is kept but not forwarded to (for maintenance, updates or isolation); takes effect after publishing. Each group needs at least one on. e.g. http://10.10.10.8/human [on] gets requests, http://10.10.10.9/human [off] paused
backend.minOne: At least one host is required

systemRoutes.title: System routes (read-only)
systemRoutes.description: These paths are defined in the gateway settings file, are not affected by publishing, and cannot be used by entries.

split.stickyHint: A client stays in the same group for this many days; 0 = not sticky
split.forceHeaderHint: Requests with this header (value = group key, e.g. B) go to that group
split.rollbackHint: When a non-control group's 5xx rate stays above the threshold, all traffic returns to the control group
split.endConfirm: An ended experiment can only run again after changing its settings and publishing. End it?

publish.warnings: Please double-check ({{count}}); publishing is still allowed

issues.EXPERIMENT_WEIGHT_SUM: A/B group shares total {{sum}}; they must total 100

issues.EXPERIMENT_TIME_RANGE: The A/B experiment end time must be after its start time

issues.EXPERIMENT_ROLLBACK_RULE: The A/B experiment auto-rollback rule is invalid
issues.ROUTE_HOST_IS_BACKEND_ADDRESS: Entry {{routeKey}} uses domain {{host}}, which matches host address {{address}}. Domains are what clients use to reach the gateway, not backend addresses; leave empty to accept any domain
